title: 第五章 新节目策划与调皮的雪姐（求追读）
slug: 华娱从继承视频网站开始
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“好！”

钟大强把苏行舟的吩咐一一记下，继续把其他事情进度一一汇报：

“关于新节目主持人的招募，还是没有合适的。”

苏行舟点头，招不到人在他意料之中。

即使现在是互联网人才井喷的时代，想要招到一个满足要求的吐槽脱口秀口播主持人也是难如登天的事情。

没错，苏行舟想要开设一档新栏目。

对标搜狐视频的《大鹏嘚吧嘚》，猕猴桃的《娱乐猛回头》，优酷土豆的《不吐不快》，《暴走大事件》这样的短平快，娱乐吐槽类节目。

p站能拿得出手的节目太少，苏行舟打算从这类轻脱口秀入手，丰富平台内容品类。

这种敢吐槽，高尺度的短平快吐槽脱口秀正是当下年轻人情绪宣泄的载体，他们能看到对娱乐圈，精英阶层，八卦舆论的调侃。

最关键的是，p站和苏行舟需要这样的节目作为自己的“喉舌”。

别看现在被人骂得狗血淋头，但苏行舟迟早是要反攻的，那一天不会太久。

但这类节目也很难搞出爆款。

因为这类节目以主持人为IP，能写敢说，且有语感懂娱乐圈的主持人全网不超过5个，这也是为什么大鹏，王尼玛等人能快速冒头的原因。

这样的人才多是草根出身。

传统主持人培养体系，科班出身的人都不适合这类型的综艺，野生网感的天赋是绝对稀缺资源。

想靠招聘找到这样的人才还是太难了。

不过，苏行舟恰好就知道一个科班出身，却有草根网感天赋的人才。

“TCgirls那边联系上了吗？”

钟大强连忙点头：

“联系上了，但是对节目的形式有点异议。”

钟大强不知道苏行舟是怎么发现这么小的博主的，TCgirls就在微博发布了几条随拍吐槽视频，粉丝量甚至不过千。

“什么？”

“她不愿意做这种直接吐槽明星，娱乐圈八卦的脱口秀节目。”钟大强回忆起当时的对话，对这个女生有些印象深刻：

“她反客为主，问我们有没有兴趣搞一档不聊娱乐圈瓜，和社会时政，而是针对都市社会年轻人生活痛点吐槽，还有男女情感和职场焦虑的节目。”

这就是钟大强对这个姓姜的女生印象深刻的原因，不愧是中戏的研究生，很有自己的见解。

苏行舟听完笑了。

不愧是未来的“papi酱”，已经初见雏形。

不愿意吐槽明星，是对个人IP的考量？

“约她见一面！”

苏行舟没有废话，直接干脆利落地下了决定。

在他看来，这两档节目完全可以一起开，一个是他现在需要的，一个是她未来需要的。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Okay!"

Zhong Daqiang wrote down Su Xingzhou's instructions one by one, and continued to report the progress of other matters one by one:

"As for the recruitment of new program hosts, there is still no suitable one."

Su Xingzhou nodded, as he expected that he would not be able to recruit anyone.

Even now in an era of Internet talent explosion, it is extremely difficult to recruit a talk show host who meets the requirements.

That's right, Su Xingzhou wants to open a new column.

Comparing with Sohu Video's "Dapeng's Bar", Kiwi's "Entertainment Turn Back", Youku Tudou's "Don't Spit, Not Happy", "Rampage Event" and other short, fast, entertainment and complaining programs.

Station P has too few programs to offer, so Su Xingzhou plans to start with this type of light talk show to enrich the platform’s content categories.

This kind of high-standard, short-form, fast-talking talk show that dares to complain is the vehicle for young people to vent their emotions. They can see ridicule of the entertainment industry, elites, and gossip.

The most important thing is that Station P and Su Xingzhou need this kind of program as their "mouthpiece".

Even though he is being scolded so much now, Su Xingzhou will counterattack sooner or later, and that day won't be long.

But it’s also difficult for this kind of show to become a hit.

Because this type of program uses the host as the IP, there are no more than 5 hosts on the entire network who can write, dare to speak, and have a sense of language and understanding of the entertainment industry. This is why Dapeng, Wang Nima and others can quickly emerge.

Most of these talents come from grassroots backgrounds.

In the traditional host training system, people with a professional background are not suitable for this type of variety show. The talent of wild Internet sense is an absolutely scarce resource.

It is still too difficult to find such talents through recruitment.

However, Su Xingzhou happened to know a talent who came from a professional background but had a talent for grassroots networking.

"Have you contacted TCgirls?"

Zhong Daqiang nodded quickly:

"I got in touch, but I have some objections to the format of the show."

Zhong Daqiang didn't know how Su Xingzhou discovered such a small blogger. TCgirls posted several random videos of complaints on Weibo, and the number of fans was less than a thousand.

"What?"

"She doesn't want to do this kind of talk show that directly complains about celebrities and gossips about the entertainment industry." Zhong Daqiang recalled the conversation at that time, and was somewhat impressed by this girl:

"She was mainly anti-customer and asked us if we were interested in creating a program that would not talk about the entertainment industry or current social affairs, but would focus on the pain points in the lives of young people in urban society, as well as the emotions between men and women and workplace anxieties."

This is the reason why Zhong Daqiang is deeply impressed by this girl named Jiang. She is worthy of being a graduate student in Chinese drama, and she has her own opinions.

Su Xingzhou laughed after hearing this.

As expected of the future "papi sauce", it has already begun to take shape.

Is the reluctance to complain about celebrities a consideration for personal IP?

"Ask her to meet!"

Su Xingzhou didn't waste any words and made a decision directly and neatly.

In his opinion, these two programs can be launched together. One is what he needs now, and the other is what she needs in the future.
